review_candidates.title: Senior AI Engineer
review_candidates.description: AI senior engineer Key Responsibilities • Design and develop AI/ML solutions for real-world business use cases. • Build and integrate LLM-based applications, including RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, and tool/function calling. • Work with open-source and commercial foundation models and evaluate their performance for different use cases. • Develop AI pipelines covering data preparation, model evaluation, fine-tuning, inference, and deployment. • Build scalable and reliable AI services and APIs for production environments. • Work with GPU infrastructure, model serving, vector databases, and AI platforms. • Develop AI applications using frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph or equivalent technologies. • Establish best practices for AI development, evaluation, security, observability, and lifecycle management. • Lead technical discussions and contribute to the architecture and design of AI platforms and solutions. • Mentor junior and mid-level AI engineers and help build the team’s technical capabilities. • Stay up to date with the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem and translate relevant technologies into practical solutions.
